avis.texte: This product is amazing. It's not to be used every day. 1-2x a week is truly enough. My skin really glows after each use. It's extremely strong, so I definitely do not recommend using it more than twice a week. This isn't just an exfoliant. It actually is more of an OTC chemical peel. I make sure to wear sunscreen after using because my skin gets pretty sensitive to the sun, as to be expected, after each use. After seeing how Clinique discontinues really good products in favor of multi-step products in smaller quantities but higher cost to do the exact same job, I figured it was only a matter of time before this product went "out of stock". I expect it'll be back in a different formulation to push the buyer towards a multi product bundle. Honestly, if you're trying to maintain a consistent routine, this company is an okay start with some decent products, but don't expect them to stay around long.
I wish i had of taken before and after pictures. I seen results after my first use!! ❤️
Love how this product goes on smoothly and easily. One use and I was hooked!! Love this product!!

It was the best product ever.

This peel made my face perfect. The skin tone has become more even, pores are less noticeable, and the oily sheen that always irritated me has disappeared. I really regret that I didn't try this product earlier.

I'm 31 and did not start really caring about my skin care routine until a few years ago. After 2 babies and years of living on and off the beach, I developed dark spots and started struggling with acne. When I added this to my routine, I saw a majorly noticeable difference in my complexion and the darkness of my spots. All the tiny bumps on my cheeks are gone, clean pores! My jawline acne is completely in check. Even on my period, no breakouts!
Winter air in the desert is not my friend. My face gets really dry with cracked flakes. This peel helps alleviate it so that my makeup goes on smoothly.

I have always taken care of my skin since my teenage years and I have been rewarded with an appearance of at least 10 years younger than my age . I live in a very dry climate and require multiple products for moisturizing. As I have aged, I developed brown spots. Although wrinkles have not been my primary concern, I wanted to begin using retinol products. I typically do not have sensitive skin but I found that I had to discontinue even after reading about ways to avoid irritation. I may try again in a month or so. My point is, I have somewhat sensitive and typically very dry skin. I have had NO problems with this product. I have used the Clinique system for years and find that at times when I omit the clarifying lotion or rush through the steps, I get small bumps on my forehead. This product leaves my skin so smooth. I do feel a slight tingling after application but after a few moments that goes away. I use moisture surge on the driest areas on top of my typical moisturizer to alleviate the sensation. Again, I have used the Clinique regime for decades so I think that some people may want to start a consistent program making sure to incorporate the clarifying lotion. You can't expect one product to change your appearance. You have to be diligent and let your skin acclimate to changes. Then, try products such as this one after reading all the directions. I will admit that this sat on my shelf for a bit until I read and understood how to apply it and when. I may use it in my T-z

avis.titre: A new staple in my skin care
avis.texte: I have used Clinique skincare and makeup for 35 years. My skin is pretty sensitive so I was a little worried about trying this. It did not cause any irritation whatsoever. This product really works. It makes my skin so soft, clear and healthy looking. I use 3 times per week and am very happy with results. This will be in my skincare routine forever.

The minute I open the bottle I smelled a strong alcohol smell. I thought I would give it a try anyway and my skin started to burn. I do not understand why Clinique puts so much alcohol in their products. Alcohol dries out your skin so much. Not good for the skin.

This product has been a great addition to my routine! I've suffered from cystic acne in the past and this didn't cure it (going to a Romanian esthetician did that) but it's been keeping my skin super fresh and flowing along with the tea tree oil face wash I use and once a month glycolic peel/facial that I get. It's an inexpensive way to keep your skin looking amazing in-between peels/facials. There seems to be some misunderstanding with some of these reviewers on here- this isn't a full on 'peel' like the thicker glycolic peel I get from my esthetician- I don't know why some people think that's what it is- it's definitively not marketed that way. If that's what you're looking for, I suggest you consult a professional. Like any OTC product, this will not cure your acne, cystic acne, dark spots, or clogged pores, but it is an amazing alternative that keeps your skin looking great in-between treatments. Or if you don't need serious help and you just need a boost to your usual face wash/serum/moisturizer this product is definitely worth the money. I'd suggest trying it out and using it 3X a week. This in conjunction with my facials has worked wonders. I'm 38 with no dark spots, no breaks outs and no wrinkles!

It is indeed very impressive on the outside with the 32% of the 7-acid blend of AHAs/BHA/PHA. However, after trying it, I can safely say that Clinique did stay on the safe side, rather than taking chance on their costumer's complaints of irritation after using such a high (salon and Derm.) strength acid product. Due to the very high amount of alcohol, the product will barely have time to stay. let alone penetrate into the epidermis. It will be actually undetected without having any (major) effect. A product with 1% AHA would be able to deliver the same result as this one. Since regulations demand that the weight of raw-materials that go into the product at production that creates the ingredients listing (rather than what is actually left in the product), makes it possible to have this impressive array of acids but in reality having a very mild and safe product. Where I think it is disappointing for us consumers, is that one has purchased the product on false premises. The Lancome Clarifique Face Essence with its 3% Glycolic Acid does deliver more after application than this product from Clinique. Price "seems" to be attractive, however, it is only 30 ml (1 o.z.) for 34 USD. Lancome Clarifique Face Essence is 150 ml (5 o.z.) for 95 USD. As we can clearly see, the product from Clinique is a much higher priced one. I find this product an excellent example of "clever marketing" and that's about it. It did not deliver on its promise (it did not irritate my sensitive skin either).
